researchQuestion: How sensitive are representative annual PV estimates and equal-capacity array choices to source-year inclusion and representative-month scoring?
site: Existing Sheffield research scenario; not a surveyed or metered plant
sourceProduct: Open-Meteo ERA5 reanalysis; no simulated fallback

arrayCandidates.rationale: Bounded exploration around the existing32degree south-facing scenario using existing optimiser increments of10degree tilt and18degree azimuth; not surveyed feasibility or a global optimum

weightPolicy: Retain existing variable weights; independently remove persistence/continuity terms, without tuning for favourable outcomes
decisionObjective: Annual AC energy, fixed DC capacity and inverter; seasonal energy reported separately
nominalRule: Maximise generation under default representative-year weather
robustRule: Minimise maximum energy regret across four historical weather years; disclose ties
regretDefinition: For option a and scenario s, max_b energy(b,s) minus energy(a,s)
evaluationPolicy: Retrospective descriptive stability, not forecast generalisation. Historical2025 results were previously inspected. Benefit is in-scenario and may be zero; retain all cases.
metrics: candidate month score components and margin
deviation from four-year mean and median
boundaries: No calibrated future probabilities from four years
Independent model reference comparison and participant evaluation outside first experiment
expectedNegativeCase: If one array wins every tested year, robustness adds diagnostic evidence but no decision improvement. Report without changing cases.
